body: DESIGN CHECKPOINT — bd-01M15B7CRW8ER7D8HSF3D24Z13, no edits or reservations yet. Proposed compiler contract: (1) add closed CodexScale = SurfaceUnit(SurfaceUnitKind) | NarrativeUnit(Situations | Segments(SegmentKind)); default Sentence only for source compatibility. Exact target mapping is Token→FeatureTarget.Token, Sentence→Sentence, Clause/Paragraph→SurfaceUnit whose atlas kind matches, Situations→Situation, Segments(k)→Segment whose model node kind is k. Window targets remain a later recipe-scale case, not silently coerced. (2) CodexSpec carries scale; config checksum bumps to v2 and binds its canonical rendering; CodexContract carries scale; textual twin names it. Existing non-feature claim/entity/context/relation annotations remain visible rather than being hidden by a feature scale. (3) A selected feature space is resolved from FeatureSelection. Raw(space) uses space directly. Derived becomes Derived(derivation: Checksum, basisId: Option[Checksum] = None): None resolves the existing derived:<short derivation> space; Some is retained in identity/config but honestly remains unresolved until features.BasisId and outputSpaceId(basis) land. Then the slot changes to Option[BasisId] without changing the ADT shape. (4) For refs in the resolved space and selected scale, when the Feature annotation channel is active, compile TextAnnotation(kind=Feature, target=FeatureAddress.Observation(space,target), support from one SupportResolver over model.atlas + situation/segment supports). Every support is passed through EvidenceVisibility.clipSupport; reader-invisible targets emit no mark. These annotations enter TextAnnotation.coalesce and LaneAllocation exactly like every other mark, so no renderer-only feature lane. FeatureChannelState observationCount becomes the at-scale count, not total refs in the space. Missing/sidecar-required remains distinct from numeric zero. (5) Audit upstream carries FeatureAddress.Space(space), plus FeatureAddress.Derivation(id) for Derived; the view provenance config checksum already binds the full CommonViewState selection and scale. I therefore read 'provenance carries FeatureSelection' as CodexContract.feature + config checksum + per-annotation audit addresses, not a duplicate FeatureSelection field on ViewProvenance. Please correct that interpretation if you intended ViewProvenance itself to grow a field. (6) Laws/tests: exact scale-target filtering; V-E3 equality to horizon-clipped resolved support for paragraph/situation/scene at omniscient and reader horizons; HorizonShared only through EvidenceVisibility; feature annotations allocated or explicit overflow, never dropped; missing at wrong scale; input-order determinism; config differs by scale/basis; textual twin names scale and selection. Scope proposal: compiler.scala, visibility.scala, codex.scala, CodexCompilerSuite, CodexFlowSuite only if contract validation needs it, and WOG CodexCompilerSuite. Awaiting chief checkpoint before mote begin.
